subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add off-root `SKILL.md` orphan detection, and should it run only in explicit diagnostics such as `openclaw skills check` or Doctor?
rationale: The gap is source-reproducible, but the permanent behavior requires a product choice about filesystem scan scope, timing, privacy, performance, false positives, and whether startup should warn.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add a bounded orphan detector to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and actionable remediation wording.

options.title: Also Warn At Startup
options.body: Add startup or gateway-status warnings too, accepting extra runtime scanning and possible operator-visible noise for faster discovery.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured skill roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root filesystem discovery.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add a bounded orphan detector to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and actionable remediation wording.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans recent Skill Workshop lifecycle, skills CLI, and status/diagnostic surfaces where this owner has the strongest recent history.
